remediations.title: Cross-Tenant BOLA Protection on Case Mutation Endpoints
remediations.changes_summary: Added _enforce_case_tenant(case, caller_tenant) helper and wired caller_tenant: TenantDep across list_cases, update_case_status, escalate_case, sign_case, resolve_case, validate_case_transition, verify_case_timeline, add_note, link_alert, get_timeline, export_case, download_sar_report, register_evidence, get_case_evidence, file_sar_report, export_fincen_xml_endpoint, and copilot endpoints.

remediations.title: Elimination of Arbitrary UUID Dummy Mock Case Synthesis
remediations.changes_summary: Removed general is_uuid regex fallback in get_case. Non-existent UUIDs now truthfully return None (HTTP 404), preserving only explicit canonical demo cases.

remediations.title: Enforcement of Terminal Case Immutability on Reassignment and Alert Linking
remediations.changes_summary: Added TerminalCaseImmutableError checks in assign_case and link_alert when case is finalized in CLOSED_CONFIRMED or CLOSED_FALSE_POSITIVE status.

remediations.title: Optimistic Concurrency Control for Lost Update Prevention
remediations.changes_summary: Added expected_status precondition to CaseStatusRequest and change_status. When current status does not match expected_status, returns HTTP 409 Conflict.

remediations.title: Precondition Enforcement on FinCEN SAR XML Generation
remediations.changes_summary: Enforced status validation in file_sar_report, rejecting CLOSED_FALSE_POSITIVE and unreviewed OPEN/ASSIGNED cases with HTTP 400 upfront.

remediations.title: Deterministic Stable Webhook Event ID for Replay Deduplication
remediations.changes_summary: Derived stable event ID evt_<sha256(tenant:type:id)[:12]> from payload object identity in dispatch_event, ensuring Kafka redeliveries share identical delivery ID for external deduplication.
